sn35.139:1.1: Yam bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ tam pajahatha ||
sn35.139:1.2: taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati || ||
sn35.139:1.5: te pajahatha || te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || ||
sn35.139:1.11: te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || || 9
sn35.139:1.12: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yam imasmiṃ Jetavane tiṇakaṭṭhaṃ || la || 10
sn35.139:1.13: Evam eva kho bhikkhave rūpā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha || te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti || || Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || Dhammā na tumhākaṃ te pajahatha ||
sn35.139:1.14: te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissantīti || || 3
